provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code on the ring x^315 - 1 with a(x) = x^15 + x^35 + x^40 + x^62 + x^86 + x^98 + x^126 + x^142 + x^185 + x^195 + x^205 + x^207 + x^239 + x^286 + x^295, b(x) = x^7 + x^12 + x^45 + x^60 + x^99 + x^167 + x^223 + x^251 + x^310; H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)], H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T].
provenance.notes: Found by a randomized sweep over sparse polynomial pairs, screened against the live board before any expensive work. Checked for single-block logicals via the ideal generated by (x^m - 1)/gcd(a, x^m - 1) before the distance was believed.
